description: Exact availability and all-in price for one stay, tour or experience. Stays: checks the dates against the host's calendars, existing bookings, minimum stay and capacity, and returns the itemised total (accommodation, discounts, fees, tax) in AMD. Tours and experiences: returns the open time slots with seats left for that date and the total for the party. Also returns the cancellation terms, how payment works, and a link to book. Hotels list their room types (rooms are chosen on the listing page). Read-only: nothing is held or booked.

endDate.description: Stays only: check-out date, YYYY-MM-DD (the night before is the last night).

startDate.description: Check-in date for stays, or the activity date; YYYY-MM-DD.

name: get_quote
title: Get an exact quote
